name: Hanuman Sitting on His Coiled Tail in Lanka
visual_description: Lord Hanuman sitting calmly atop a massive coiled stack of his own tail inside Ravana's royal court.
usage_context: Used to show creating your own platform, asserting dominance, or elevating yourself when disrespected or denied a seat.

example.top_text: WHEN THEY DON'T INVITE YOU TO THE MEETING
example.bottom_text: SO YOU HOST YOUR OWN SUMMIT

text_areas.description: Setup or situation where one is denied respect or a seat
Punchline about flexing or creating your own high ground
